ll par[1100000];
ll findRoot(ll x) {
    if (par[x] == x) return x;
    return par[x] = findRoot(par[x]);
}

void mergeSets(ll x, ll y) {
    ll rootX = findRoot(x);
    ll rootY = findRoot(y);
    if (rootX != rootY) {
        par[rootX] = rootY;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    for (ll i = 0; i < p; i++) {

    }

            mergeSets(val, i);
        }
    }

        components.insert(findRoot(i));
    }

    ll componentCount = components.size();
    if (k == 1) {
        componentCount = p;
    }

    const ll MOD = 1000000007;
    ll result = 1;
    for (ll i = 0; i < componentCount; i++) {
        result = (result * p) % MOD;
    }
    cout << result << '\n';
